familiar.text: (Though Jesus himself baptized not, but his disciples,)

familiar.text: And he must needs go through Samaria.

verses.restored: He comes therefore to a city of Samaria called Sychar, near the field Jacob had given to Joseph his son.

familiar.text: Then cometh he to a city of Samaria, which is called Sychar, near to the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.

familiar.text: Now Jacob’s well was there. Jesus therefore, being wearied with his journey, sat thus on the well: and it was about the sixth hour.

verses.restored: A woman from Samaria comes to draw water. Jesus says to her, Give me to drink.

familiar.text: There cometh a woman of Samaria to draw water: Jesus saith unto her, Give me to drink.

verses.restored: For his disciples had gone away into the city to buy food.

familiar.text: (For his disciples were gone away unto the city to buy meat.)

verses.restored: The Samaritan woman says to him, How is it that you, being a Judean, ask a drink from me, being a Samaritan woman? For Judeans do not share vessels with Samaritans.

familiar.text: Then saith the woman of Samaria unto him, How is it that thou, being a Jew, askest drink of me, which am a woman of Samaria? for the Jews have no dealings with the Samaritans.

verses.restored: Jesus answered and said to her, If you knew the gift of the Divine and who it is saying to you, Give me to drink, you would have asked him, and he would have given you living water.

familiar.text: Jesus answered and said unto her, If thou knewest the gift of God, and who it is that saith to thee, Give me to drink; thou wouldest have asked of him, and he would have given thee living water.

verses.restored: She says to him, Lord, you have no bucket, and the well is deep; from where then do you have the living water?

familiar.text: The woman saith unto him, Sir, thou hast nothing to draw with, and the well is deep: from whence then hast thou that living water?

verses.restored: Are you greater than our father Jacob, who gave us the well and drank from it himself, and his sons and his livestock?

familiar.text: Art thou greater than our father Jacob, which gave us the well, and drank thereof himself, and his children, and his cattle?

verses.restored: Jesus answered and said to her, Everyone drinking from this water will thirst again.

familiar.text: Jesus answered and said unto her, Whosoever drinketh of this water shall thirst again:

verses.restored: But whoever drinks from the water that I will give will certainly not thirst into the age; but the water that I will give will become in that one a spring of water leaping up into age-long life.

familiar.text: But whosoever drinketh of the water that I shall give him shall never thirst; but the water that I shall give him shall be in him a well of water springing up into everlasting life.

verses.restored: The woman says to him, Lord, give me this water, so that I may not thirst nor come here to draw.

familiar.text: The woman saith unto him, Sir, give me this water, that I thirst not, neither come hither to draw.

verses.restored: He says to her, Go, call your husband and come here.

familiar.text: Jesus saith unto her, Go, call thy husband, and come hither.

verses.restored: The woman answered and said to him, I do not have a husband. Jesus says to her, You spoke beautifully/well: I do not have a husband.

familiar.text: The woman answered and said, I have no husband. Jesus said unto her, Thou hast well said, I have no husband:

familiar.text: For thou hast had five husbands; and he whom thou now hast is not thy husband: in that saidst thou truly.

verses.restored: The woman says to him, Lord, I behold that you are a prophet.

familiar.text: The woman saith unto him, Sir, I perceive that thou art a prophet.

verses.restored: Our fathers worshiped on this mountain, and you say that in Jerusalem is the place where it is necessary to worship.

familiar.text: Our fathers worshipped in this mountain; and ye say, that in Jerusalem is the place where men ought to worship.

verses.restored: Jesus says to her, Trust me, woman, an hour is coming when neither on this mountain nor in Jerusalem will you worship the Father.

familiar.text: Jesus saith unto her, Woman, believe me, the hour cometh, when ye shall neither in this mountain, nor yet at Jerusalem, worship the Father.

familiar.text: Ye worship ye know not what: we know what we worship: for salvation is of the Jews.

verses.restored: But an hour is coming, and now is, when the true worshipers will worship the Father in Spirit and truth; for indeed the Father seeks such ones worshiping him.

familiar.text: But the hour cometh, and now is, when the true worshippers shall worship the Father in spirit and in truth: for the Father seeketh such to worship him.

verses.restored: The Divine is Spirit, and those worshiping must worship in Spirit and truth.

familiar.text: God is a Spirit: and they that worship him must worship him in spirit and in truth.

verses.restored: The woman says to him, I know that Messiah is coming, the one called Anointed; when that one comes, he will announce all things to us.

familiar.text: The woman saith unto him, I know that Messias cometh, which is called Christ: when he is come, he will tell us all things.

verses.restored: Jesus says to her, I am, the one speaking to you.

familiar.text: Jesus saith unto her, I that speak unto thee am he.

familiar.text: And upon this came his disciples, and marvelled that he talked with the woman: yet no man said, What seekest thou? or, Why talkest thou with her?

familiar.text: Say not ye, There are yet four months, and then cometh harvest? behold, I say unto you, Lift up your eyes, and look on the fields; for they are white already to harvest.

familiar.text: And he that reapeth receiveth wages, and gathereth fruit unto life eternal: that both he that soweth and he that reapeth may rejoice together.

verses.restored: For in this the word is true: One is sowing and another reaping.

familiar.text: And herein is that saying true, One soweth, and another reapeth.

familiar.text: I sent you to reap that whereon ye bestowed no labour: other men laboured, and ye are entered into their labours.

familiar.text: And many of the Samaritans of that city believed on him for the saying of the woman, which testified, He told me all that ever I did.

familiar.text: So Jesus came again into Cana of Galilee, where he made the water wine. And there was a certain nobleman, whose son was sick at Capernaum.

familiar.text: Jesus saith unto him, Go thy way; thy son liveth. And the man believed the word that Jesus had spoken unto him, and he went his way.

familiar.text: And as he was now going down, his servants met him, and told him, saying, Thy son liveth.

familiar.text: So the father knew that it was at the same hour, in the which Jesus said unto him, Thy son liveth: and himself believed, and his whole house.

familiar.text: This is again the second miracle that Jesus did, when he was come out of Judaea into Galilee.
